set_aside.subject: import projects with their identity
set_aside.text: “with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept), links intact” conflicts with R0-86: “the object has no id of its own.”
set_aside.question: Does “ids kept” exclude the object, and should the import output explicitly say that only project, customer, room and pointer identities are preserved while the object is embedded in its project?
options: The object has no id; preserve only project, customer, room and pointer ids
The imported object retains some legacy identity despite R0-86
set_aside.default_guess: Treat the object as an embedded, unidentified part of the imported project and preserve only the other stated identities.

set_aside.subject: Carried to later states — anonymised project model
set_aside.text: State 1 still carries “what an anonymised project keeps exactly (R0-60)”, while R0-87 says it keeps “the mark that it was anonymised” beside “its id, status and artifact pointers.”
set_aside.question: Is R0-87's list exhaustive, leaving State 1 only to define the fields and representation, or may State 1 decide that an anonymised project keeps additional facts?
options: R0-87 is exhaustive; remove the carried question
State 1 may choose additional retained facts
State 1 may only define the representation of the four retained categories
set_aside.default_guess: Treat R0-87 as exhaustive and carry only the representation and field definitions to State 1.
